publishing.github_write_strategy: Use .recommendation/PUBLISHING.md and immutable publication bundles. Prefer one ordinary Git commit per repository/stage with the actual base tree SHA, current parent commit and non-force ref update; otherwise use serial Contents API mutations with fresh matching blob SHAs.
publishing.transaction_order: Verify current selection and all final payloads; persist/read back immutable PREPARED bundle; apply stage 1 then stage 2 where applicable, grouped per repository; read back complete notes/manifests and append-only history; only then write/read back independent QA receipt.
publishing.same_day_retries: Load the original bundle, digest and frozen payloads; resume only missing stages. Same-operation reservations are not new duplicates. Preserve every earlier exposure and user Notes; divergent target content is a conflict.
publishing.on_409: Refetch latest content and SHA; reconcile changes rather than overwriting.
publishing.on_422: Inspect validation message; do not blindly retry unchanged payload.
publishing.on_403_or_429: Capture raw error and exposed rate-limit headers; obey Retry-After or reset. If permission denied, stop.
publishing.on_transport_error_or_5xx: Fetch target before retry because commit may have succeeded despite lost response.
publishing.failure_audit: Record UTC time, operation, path, HTTP status/message if exposed, SHA/commit if known. Never store secrets.
publishing.success_gate: Only report full success after exact ID, semantic duplicate, verification and post-write readback gates pass.
publishing.legacy_findings: Retain historical source/format findings as explicit backlog without deleting or replacing exposed content. They do not waive current-publication source gates. Broken history or inconsistent music mirrors blocks publication.
